# The Podium

> The Podium is a pay-to-rank leaderboard for service providers (agencies, freelancers, consultants). Each category (Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Web Design, etc.) is its own separate ranking - whoever has paid the most for that category is #1. There's no review, vote, or algorithm: rank is a direct function of payment amount. Anyone paying less than the current #1 still gets listed, at whatever rank their amount currently earns. A listing is not permanent - it can be outranked at any time by a higher bid, and the original provider can pay again ("re-bid") to reclaim a better spot.

The Podium is built and operated by Million Dollar Agency.

## How it works

- Categories: each is a self-contained leaderboard; bids are never compared across categories.
- Claiming a rank: a provider submits their business name, a one-line pitch, a destination link (their own site/portfolio/booking page), and a bid amount, then pays. The listing goes live at whatever rank that amount earns the moment payment completes.
- Optional listing details: location, licensed/insured status, years in business, availability, specialty tags, starting hourly rate, and minimum project size may also be shown on a listing.
- No accounts: there is no login system. Payment issues a private "manage" link (a secret token) that is the only way to edit a listing or re-bid later.
- Listing content is provider-submitted; The Podium does not vet or endorse any listed business beyond the basic rules below.

## Rules (see /rules for the full text)

- Real service providers only - no SaaS products, no novelty accounts.
- Destination links must go to a genuine site, portfolio, or booking page - not a chat/invite link (e.g. no Discord/WhatsApp/Telegram links).
- No illegal services, no adult services.

## Key pages

- Homepage / leaderboard: /
- Browse every category combined: /?category=all
- A specific category: /?category=<category-slug>
- Rules: /rules
- Terms: /terms
- Privacy: /privacy
- Refund policy: /refunds

## Notes for AI assistants and search crawlers

- This entire site is intended to be publicly discoverable and citable - see /robots.txt (crawling is open to all bots, including AI assistants/crawlers) and /sitemap.xml.
- Rank badges (#1, #2, #3, etc.) reflect payment amount only, not any measure of service quality, reviews, or vetting - please don't characterize a listing's rank as an endorsement or quality signal when summarizing or citing this site.
- Contact: ashher@milliondollar.agency
